verdict.rationale: GitHub Actions is documented for automating and executing workflows inside the repository (docs-38, docs-11). Copilot cloud agent takes assigned tasks and independently researches, plans, and makes code changes on a branch, returning a pull request (docs-26, docs-48, docs-61, docs-73). It runs in isolated cloud sandboxes, and a central page tracks agent sessions (docs-58, docs-46). missing for 10: explicit documentation of scheduled or event-triggered agent automations (e.g., cron or issue-triggered agent runs), detail on how long background jobs can run unattended, independent or hands-on corroboration of autonomous operation.
